mapper.select: SELECT cr.*, ct.label AS course_label, et.label AS environment_label FROM class_record cr JOIN course_type ct ON ct.code = cr.course_code JOIN environment_type et ON et.code = cr.environment_code WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date = #{recordDate} ORDER BY cr.id

SELECT cr.*, ct.label AS course_label, et.label AS environment_label FROM class_record cr JOIN course_type ct ON ct.code = cr.course_code JOIN environment_type et ON et.code = cr.environment_code WHERE cr.id = #{id} AND cr.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_record (student_id, creator_id, record_date, course_code, course_other_description, environment_code, environment_other_description, observation_duration_minutes, overall_remark) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{creatorId}, #{recordDate}, #{courseCode}, #{courseOtherDescription}, #{environmentCode}, #{environmentOtherDescription}, #{observationDurationMinutes}, #{overallRemark})
mapper.update: UPDATE class_record SET record_date = #{recordDate}, course_code = #{courseCode}, course_other_description = #{courseOtherDescription}, environment_code = #{environmentCode}, environment_other_description = #{environmentOtherDescription}, observation_duration_minutes = #{observationDurationMinutes}, overall_remark = #{overallRemark} WHERE id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM course_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM environment_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM behavior_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM behavior_stage_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM behavior_function_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM behavior_status_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM assistance_type WHERE code = #{code}

SELECT option_row.dimension, option_row.code, option_row.label, option_row.group_code, group_row.label AS group_label, group_row.display_order AS group_display_order, option_row.display_order, option_row.requires_custom_text FROM abc_tag_option option_row JOIN abc_tag_group group_row ON group_row.dimension = option_row.dimension AND group_row.code = option_row.group_code ORDER BY FIELD(option_row.dimension, 'ANTECEDENT', 'CONSEQUENCE'), group_row.display_order, option_row.display_order

SELECT behavior.code, behavior.label, module.code AS module_code, module.label AS module_label, module.display_order AS module_display_order, metadata.display_order FROM behavior_catalog_metadata metadata JOIN behavior_type behavior ON behavior.code = metadata.behavior_code JOIN behavior_module module ON module.code = metadata.module_code WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY module.display_order, metadata.display_order

SELECT behavior_group.code AS group_code, behavior_group.label AS group_label, behavior_group.display_order AS group_display_order, item.behavior_code, item.display_order AS item_display_order FROM behavior_catalog_metadata metadata JOIN behavior_group_item item ON item.behavior_code = metadata.behavior_code JOIN behavior_group behavior_group ON behavior_group.code = item.group_code WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY behavior_group.module_code, behavior_group.display_order, item.display_order

SELECT DISTINCT status_row.group_code, status_row.code, status_row.label, status_row.display_order FROM behavior_catalog_metadata metadata JOIN behavior_group_item item ON item.behavior_code = metadata.behavior_code JOIN behavior_group_status_option status_row ON status_row.group_code = item.group_code WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY status_row.group_code, status_row.display_order

SELECT option_row.code, option_row.behavior_code, option_row.option_type, option_row.parent_option_code, option_row.label, option_row.display_order, option_row.requires_custom_text FROM behavior_catalog_metadata metadata JOIN behavior_catalog_option option_row ON option_row.behavior_code = metadata.behavior_code WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY metadata.module_code, metadata.display_order, option_row.option_type, option_row.display_order

SELECT relation.behavior_code, relation.course_code AS code FROM behavior_catalog_metadata metadata JOIN course_behavior_config relation ON relation.behavior_code = metadata.behavior_code WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY relation.behavior_code, relation.course_code

SELECT relation.behavior_code, relation.environment_code AS code FROM behavior_catalog_metadata metadata JOIN behavior_environment_config relation ON relation.behavior_code = metadata.behavior_code WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY relation.behavior_code, relation.environment_code

SELECT relation.behavior_code, relation.standard_number, goal.goal_text, relation.sub_behavior_code FROM behavior_catalog_metadata metadata JOIN behavior_training_goal relation ON relation.behavior_code = metadata.behavior_code JOIN training_goal goal ON goal.standard_number = relation.standard_number WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY relation.behavior_code, relation.standard_number

SELECT code, behavior_code, option_type, parent_option_code, label, display_order, requires_custom_text FROM behavior_catalog_option WHERE behavior_code = #{behaviorCode} ORDER BY option_type, display_order

SELECT bt.code AS behavior_code, bt.label AS behavior_label, COUNT(br.id) AS count, latest.id AS latest_record_id, latest.detail_saved AS latest_detail_saved FROM ( SELECT behavior_code FROM behavior_catalog_metadata metadata WHERE ( #{courseCode} = 'ALL_DAY_SUMMARY' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM course_behavior_config course_config WHERE course_config.course_code = #{courseCode} AND course_config.behavior_code = metadata.behavior_code ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM behavior_environment_config environment_config WHERE environment_config.environment_code = #{environmentCode} AND environment_config.behavior_code = metadata.behavior_code ) UNION SELECT behavior_code FROM behavior_record WHERE class_record_id = #{classRecordId} ) relevant JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = relevant.behavior_code LEFT JOIN behavior_record br ON br.class_record_id = #{classRecordId} AND br.behavior_code = relevant.behavior_code LEFT JOIN behavior_record latest ON latest.id = ( SELECT newest.id FROM behavior_record newest WHERE newest.class_record_id = #{classRecordId} AND newest.behavior_code = relevant.behavior_code ORDER BY newest.occurred_at DESC, newest.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN behavior_catalog_metadata metadata ON metadata.behavior_code = bt.code LEFT JOIN behavior_module module ON module.code = metadata.module_code GROUP BY bt.code, bt.label, latest.id, latest.detail_saved, module.display_order, metadata.display_order ORDER BY module.display_order, metadata.display_order, bt.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_record (class_record_id, creator_id, occurred_at, behavior_code, sub_behavior_code, status_code) VALUES (#{classRecordId}, #{creatorId}, #{occurredAt}, #{behaviorCode}, #{subBehaviorCode}, #{statusCode})
mapper.select: SELECT br.id, br.class_record_id, br.creator_id, br.occurred_at, br.behavior_code, bt.label AS behavior_label, br.detail_saved, br.sub_behavior_code, br.status_code FROM behavior_record br JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = br.behavior_code WHERE br.class_record_id = #{classRecordId} AND br.behavior_code = #{behaviorCode} ORDER BY br.occurred_at, br.id

SELECT br.*, bt.label AS behavior_label, stage_type.label AS stage_label, function_type.label AS function_label, status_type.label AS status_label FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = br.behavior_code LEFT JOIN behavior_stage_type stage_type ON stage_type.code = br.stage_code LEFT JOIN behavior_function_type function_type ON function_type.code = br.function_code LEFT JOIN behavior_status_type status_type ON status_type.code = br.status_code WHERE br.id = #{id} AND cr.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.delete: DELETE br FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id WHERE br.id = #{id} AND cr.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE behavior_record SET duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, stage_code = #{stageCode}, antecedent_text = #{antecedentText}, behavior_description = #{behaviorDescription}, consequence_text = #{consequenceText}, function_code = #{functionCode}, function_other_text = #{functionOtherText}, status_code = #{statusCode}, assistance_result_text = #{assistanceResultText}, detail_saved = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_record_assistance (behavior_record_id, assistance_code, content) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{code}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT bra.assistance_code AS code, bra.content, at.label, at.group_code AS `group` FROM behavior_record_assistance bra JOIN assistance_type at ON at.code = bra.assistance_code WHERE bra.behavior_record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY at.display_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_record_catalog_selection (behavior_record_id, option_code, custom_text) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{optionCode}, #{customText})
mapper.select: SELECT selection.option_code, option_row.option_type, option_row.label, option_row.parent_option_code, selection.custom_text FROM behavior_record_catalog_selection selection JOIN behavior_catalog_option option_row ON option_row.code = selection.option_code WHERE selection.behavior_record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY option_row.option_type, option_row.display_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_record_abc_tag (behavior_record_id, dimension, tag_code, custom_text) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{dimension}, #{tagCode}, #{customText})
mapper.select: SELECT selection.dimension, selection.tag_code AS code, option_row.label, option_row.group_code, group_row.label AS group_label, group_row.display_order AS group_display_order, option_row.display_order, option_row.requires_custom_text, selection.custom_text FROM behavior_record_abc_tag selection JOIN abc_tag_option option_row ON option_row.dimension = selection.dimension AND option_row.code = selection.tag_code JOIN abc_tag_group group_row ON group_row.dimension = option_row.dimension AND group_row.code = option_row.group_code WHERE selection.behavior_record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY FIELD(selection.dimension, 'ANTECEDENT', 'CONSEQUENCE'), group_row.display_order, option_row.display_order

SELECT bt.code AS behavior_code, bt.label AS behavior_label, COUNT(br.id) AS count FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = br.behavior_code WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY bt.code, bt.label ORDER BY count DESC, bt.code
